Over time you can expect to grow into an independent, capable, and confident Android developer.

About Tinder
 
Tinder connects people. 
With tens of millions of users and a presence in nearly every country on Earth, our reach is expansive—and growing fast.
 
The Globalization team sits within Product Operations and plays a critical role in shaping how we connect with people worldwide. We enable culturally relevant, hyper-localized experiences by partnering across product, design, content, and marketing to ensure Tinder resonates across borders and languages.
 
 
About the Role
 
We’re looking for an experienced and strategically minded Senior Localization Program Manager to drive Tinder’s localization efforts across APAC.
 
Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Globalization & International Growth, this role will work closely with another Program Manager to operationalize the team’s global strategy within the region — ensuring our products, content, and campaigns are not just translated, but truly built for local relevance and impact.
 
You’ll serve as a regional program lead, connecting cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Design to integrate localization early in development, optimize workflows, and surface insights that inform global decisions.
 
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of program management, technical localization, and cultural strategy, and who can scale processes across multiple markets while staying attuned to local nuance.

descriptionPlain:
At Meetic, a Match Group company, we have been pioneering online dating for over 20 years, leveraging our legacy to reinvent how people meet, connect, and build meaningful relationships across Europe and beyond. 
As part of Match Group, we manage a diverse portfolio of brands, from iconic names like Meetic, Match, Lexa, and LoveScout24 to tailored experiences for singles over 50, OurTime, DisonsDemain, Zweisam, and single parents, Even and Stir. 

Our teams design, build, and scale platforms across 20+ countries and 18 languages, ensuring every single finds the right match for their lifestyle and lifestages. We also drive growth for other Match Group brands like The League, OkCupid, Archer, Salams, and Plenty Of Fish, expanding our impact worldwide.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days / week in our office, 53 rue de Chateaudun, 75009 Paris.


Role overview :

As an Online Acquisition Apprentice, you’ll support the team in accelerating paid growth across our global portfolio of dating apps. Working closely with both the creative team and media partners, you’ll help develop and optimize acquisition strategies, contribute to campaign planning and performance analysis, and gain hands-on experience in traffic management in a dynamic, data-driven marketing environment. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how online acquisition drives business impact at scale.

How you’ll make an impact:
Help grow online acquisition across multiple dating apps and markets.
Share creative feedback and reports to improve ad performance.
Spot and launch new media partners to expand reach.
 
We could be a match if:
You are a Bachelor's or Master's student seeking an apprenticeship, ideally with a 3-weeks-in-company / 1-week-at-school schedule, but we warmly welcome other formats.
You have hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads platforms. Affiliation will be a plus.
You’re curious, proactive, rigorous, and open-minded.
You’re comfortable working with Excel or Google Sheets.
You enjoy collaborating with creative, tracking, and media partner teams.
Your familiarity with AI / LLM tools is a plus.
You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

What’s the team like?
You’ll report to a Team Lead Online Marketing and join a collaborative, data-driven and multicultural team.
You will work closely with the rest of the acquisition team with different expertise, and the creative teams. 
 
Interview Process:
A first 30 min Zoom conversation with Fatima-Ezzahra Abidi (Talent Acquisition Specialist).
A 60 onsite meeting with Yanjun Shi (Team Lead Online Marketing) including a case study.
A 60 min onsite or Zoom interview with Florent Maucourt (Sr. Online Marketing Manager) and Céline Ben Haddou (People Business Partner).

lists.content:
• 開発効率改善やパフォーマンス改善やセキュリティ対応等に強い意欲を持つ事

  • 関係者を効果的に巻き込み、成果を上げるためのオーナーシップとコミュニケーションスキル

  • AI周りのキャッチアップ・学習意欲がある・Coding Agentを使って開発した経験

  • 3年以上の商用アプリケーションの実装・リリース・運用の経験

  • AWS/Google CloudなどのPublic Cloud上で動作する商用のWebAPIを構築した経験

  • 各種テスト手法についての構築・設計経験

  • Webアプリケーションの商用コンテナイメージの作成〜運用の経験 (dockerfileや必要なmiddlewareのinstallなど)

  • Nginx, MySQLなどWebアプリケーションによく用いられるミドルウェアについての最低限の知識

  • 日本語：ビジネスレベル以上・英語：会話レベル以上

• 不正利用、悪用、ポリシー違反などの変化の速いリスク領域において、ユーザー行動やシステムログ、施策結果などのデータを自ら分析し、リスクの兆候や傾向、施策の有効性を評価しながら、検知・予防・対応の仕組みを継続的に改善した経験

  • Data Analystの支援を必要に応じて受けながらも、一定の範囲では自らデータを抽出・集計・分析し、課題の規模感、優先度、実装すべき対策の妥当性、施策の効果を評価できること

  • 対象となるユーザー行動やリスクパターンが短期間で変化し続ける環境において、自ら分析・評価を行い、その結果をもとに開発・改善につなげた経験

  • 大規模データ・アクセス数を考慮したスケーラビリティをもったデータベース・アプリケーションの設計経験・知識

  • AI開発支援ツールを活用した開発フロー・コード品質・ドキュメント作成・チームの生産性向上に取り組んだ経験

  • コンテナ環境におけるアプリケーションのデプロイスクリプトやdockerfileの構築

  • AWS/Google CloudなどPublic Cloudのインフラ構築の経験や知識

  • Webアプリケーションにおける基本的なセキュリティ対策・必要性などの知識

• Programming Languages: Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python

  • Tech Stack:  MySQL,DynamoDB,Redis,Elasticsearch, Kubernetes,and various AWS and Google Cloud services,Terraform

  • Development: Git,Github,GithubActions,Docker,Jira Cloud,Slack

  • 주요 서비스 지표(engagement, retention, revenue 등)의 상승을 위한 CRM 전략 로드맵 수립 및 실행

  • 다국적 협업자들과 영어로 업무한 경험이 있으신 분

lists.content:

  • You have hands-on experience with social listening and analytics tools (e.g., Emplifi, Meltwater, Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Google Analytics) and survey-based measurement

  • You’ve built or supported employer brand strategy and content

  • You have experience managing a corporate website/CMS and blog content

  • You’re comfortable coordinating video production and digital amplification, from creative brief through final delivery 

  • You have strong analytical skills and can turn data into clear, actionable recommendations tied to OKRs 

  • You’re comfortable working across time zones and regional teams (US, Europe, International) to keep measurement and content consistent

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills 

  • You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

• Successful individuals in this role are proactive, organized, self-directed, and can prioritize multiple projects while maintaining strict confidentiality

  • We take joy in our work—we’re lucky to tell stories about love and human connection

  • We prioritize proactive storytelling over reactive response, while still knowing how to assess risk and respond calmly when issues arise 

  • We solve problems and assume best intent. We have honest, open conversations with teammates and partners across the business

Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
We are hiring a Director of UX Research to lead research across our Dating Outcomes and Platform product areas. You will set the vision and strategy for how research informs product decisions across the core product experience at Hinge, focusing on some of Hinge's most complex research questions – understanding what's getting in the way of people forming real connections, and what Hinge needs to become to fundamentally shift how dating works online. The work is ambitious, high-stakes, and directly shapes how Hinge invests.
 
This is a senior leadership role with significant scope: you'll manage a team of researchers, own the research strategy and roadmap for Dating Outcomes and Platform, and operate as a strategic partner to group-level product, design, data science, and engineering leadership. This is an ideal role for a proven research leader who synthesizes user insights and data science findings into clear product strategy, builds the organizational conditions for teams to execute well, and thrives on ambiguous, high-impact problems.

We believe that no business brings more happiness to more people than ours; we can never forget the impact we have on society and most importantly, our community members.

In Japan more than 70 per cent of singles claim to have no partner. As the number one online dating service in Japan, we're working hard every day to help singles find their true love. Since the release of Pairs in October 2012, we have helped create opportunities for many users to find partnership and marriage. Pairs offers the opportunity to find an ideal partner that matches one's own values through various search features and a well-developed MyTag. 
Every day, we receive many reports of successful matches from across Japan and overseas. It is our hope that more and more wonderful relationships will be created, which inspires us to improve our service every day.

lists.content:
• Strategic Financial Ownership: Lead the end-to-end accounting, valuation, and forecasting for all global equity incentive plans. You are the definitive subject matter expert for ASC 718 and ASC 260 and the primary architect of the equity-related financial statement disclosures.

  • Executive Advisory & Board Reporting: Partner closely with the SVP of Financial Reporting, Legal Counsel, and the People Team. You will prepare and present high-level analysis on plan availability, burn rates, and the financial impact of proposed equity structures.

  • Global Mobility & Tax Compliance: Serve as the internal authority on the complexities of a modern workforce. You will oversee the logic for state and international mobility, ensuring that cross-border tax withholding and reporting are technically sound and compliant with local jurisdictions.

  • Advanced Forecasting & Modeling: Own the "Equity Crystal Ball." You will develop sophisticated models to forecast SBC expense, diluted shares impact, and cash flow requirements under multiple "what-if" scenarios.

  • Audit & Control Leadership: Set the standard for SOX compliance within the equity function. You will lead the relationship with external auditors, defending technical positions on valuations, and award modifications.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as the bridge between Finance, People/HR, and Legal. You will be the Accounting voice at the table providing insights into the accounting impact of daily decisions.

  • Team Mentorship: Directly manage and develop a Manager-level professional, fostering a culture of technical excellence, career growth, and extreme attention to detail.

  • Other Areas: ESPP, Section 16 filings

lists.content:
• Experience: 8-12+ years of progressive accounting experience, with 3-5+ years specifically focused on equity accounting.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting.

  • Certification: Active CPA is required.

  • Technical knowledge: Mastery of US GAAP, specifically ASC 718 and ASC 260

  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication, critical thinking, and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

• Public accounting background

  • Certified Equity Professional

  • M&A experience with equity treatment

  • Shareworks and OneStream experience

  • SEC Reporting experience
